status: development preparation plan, not a final-test freeze or an algorithm adoption decision
goal: Use real observation histories to improve first-block feature extraction and assess transfer beyond the existing simulator.
completed_now: 64 raw-window single-assistant first passes and an unlabelled independent-review package; test observations closed.
label_review: Independent review must use raw data and instructions without first-pass answers or algorithm predictions. Record disagreements and per-feature observability; never force unresolved into a negative. No independent reviewer has been claimed or contacted in this task.
expansion: Expand command-stratified development windows across the existing training/validation users, actual levels and durations. Keep non-following, quiet-limit physical changes, weak and short observations, taper, missing coverage and unclear cases. Preserve the whole user's role and report coverage rather than train only on easy cases.
supervision: Separate observable-change location/level targets from effective-threshold duration, control success and fault targets. Establish a defensible target for each feature before training it. Do not use assistant first-pass labels, received-limit edges, original CPOP or current-model results as unquestioned physical truth.
candidate_budget: At most three prospectively described development directions, including simplification of the current layered pipeline. Select one on development before any final-test inspection; keep failed candidates. Do not grow another sequence of rules by following test failures.
comparison: Preserve current effective_response_refined and original CPOP/LABS. On real data first establish compatible units, timestamps, task windows and target definitions. The present simulation-specific 30-minute model cannot be presumed valid for these four-minute labeling windows. Compare only common supported features under the same real input and scoring rules; record unavailable outputs instead of silently dropping them.
measurement: Evaluate localization plus observed level/boundary errors where references are reviewable, and true short-observation retention with false detections. Do not report an accuracy that conflates visible change with the old 0.15kW effective qualification. Do not turn a censored recovery into zero effective duration. No numerical adoption threshold is finalized from these 64 provisional cases.
final_test: Existing test and external-site user groups remain sealed. Freeze model, preprocessing, label policy, primary metric, safety tradeoff, sample size and stopping rule before one final evaluation. No final-test observations, outputs or labels have been inspected here. Final-test quality and labeling eligibility are not yet certified.
scope: First block only; retain beneficial version and baselines. No reference prediction, report writing or second-block work.
